metadata.name: Compliance & Privacy Core Infrastructure
metadata.description: Regulatory compliance framework (IRS Pub 1075, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA) and privacy controls for sensitive document handling.

irsPub1075.requirement: MailMyPDF handles taxpayer data (SSN, tax returns, financial info); must comply with IRS Publication 1075

controls.requirement: Restrict physical access to servers/hardware containing taxpayer data
controls.implementation: Data centers with badge access, biometric locks, 24/7 surveillance

controls.requirement: Only authorized personnel can access taxpayer data
controls.implementation: Role-based access, employee background checks, least privilege

controls.requirement: Encrypt taxpayer data at rest and in transit
Log all access to taxpayer data
controls.implementation: Complete audit logging (see audit logging spec)

controls.requirement: IRS must be notified of any breach of taxpayer data within 30 days
controls.implementation: Incident response procedures (see incident response spec)

controls.requirement: All employees handling taxpayer data must be trained on safeguards
controls.implementation: Annual mandatory training on data security and privacy

controls.requirement: Taxpayer data destroyed securely when retention period expires

irsPub1075.certification: Contractor must obtain annual IRS Safeguards certification

hipaa.requirement: If MailMyPDF processes health information (PHI), must comply with HIPAA
hipaa.applicability: If medical documents processed; if not, may not apply
controls: Encryption of PHI at rest and in transit
Audit logging of all PHI access
Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with covered entities

gdpr.requirement: If users are in EU, must comply with GDPR for personal data
principles: Purpose limitation (data used only for stated purpose)
Storage limitation (delete when no longer needed)

userRights.name: Right to Access
userRights.requirement: Users can request copy of their data

userRights.name: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
userRights.requirement: Users can request deletion of their data
userRights.implementation: Delete user data within 30 days; exception for legal obligations

userRights.name: Right to Rectification
userRights.implementation: Allow users to update their profile and document metadata

userRights.name: Right to Data Portability
userRights.requirement: Users can get their data in structured format
userRights.implementation: Export function: JSON, CSV, PDF of all user data

gdpr.dpa: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) required with users or their representatives

ccpa.requirement: If users are in California, must comply with CCPA for personal information
consumerRights: Right to Know: What personal data is collected
Right to Delete: Request deletion of personal data
Right to Opt-Out: Opt-out of data sales
Right to Non-Discrimination: Cannot penalize for exercising rights

implementation.privacyNotice: Provide clear privacy notice before collecting data
implementation.optOut: Provide opt-out mechanism for data sales (if applicable)

dataMinimization.principle: Collect and retain only data necessary for workflow execution
implementation: Don't collect middle names unless required
Don't collect phone numbers unless necessary
Don't store extracted data longer than needed
Don't retain PDFs after processing (unless user explicitly requests)

dataRetention.default: Delete user data after 90 days of account inactivity or explicit deletion request

workflows.taxDocuments: Retain for 7 years (IRS statute of limitations)

dataRetention.userControl: Users can request immediate deletion of their data

consentManagement.requirement: Obtain explicit user consent for data processing

consentTypes.requirement: User must accept privacy policy before creating account
User explicitly consents to processing of their documents
Separate opt-in for marketing emails (cannot be mandatory)

consentManagement.storage: Record date and method of consent; store consent logs for 7 years

thirdPartySharing.principle: Never share user data with third parties without explicit consent
exceptions: Service providers (e.g., Lob for mailing) under Data Processing Agreement

lob.requirement: When mailing documents via Lob, some data shared with Lob API
lob.dpa: Must have DPA with Lob covering this sharing
lob.userNotification: Must notify user before sharing data with Lob

breachNotification.requirement: If user data breached, must notify users and regulators

timeline.notification: Notify affected users within 72 hours (GDPR) or 30 days (IRS Pub 1075)
timeline.regulators: Notify relevant regulators (ICO for GDPR, IRS for 1075)

requirements.name: user-deletion
requirements.test: Verify user deletion removes all user data
requirements.method: Delete user; query database; verify no traces remain

requirements.name: consent-verification
requirements.test: Verify cannot process data without consent
requirements.method: Attempt to upload without accepting privacy policy; verify blocked

requirements.name: data-export
requirements.test: Verify data export includes all user data in portable format
requirements.method: Export user data; verify completeness and readability

implementation.dependencies: Must be in place before launch; affects all workflows
implementation.certification: Annual SOC 2 Type II audit; annual IRS Pub 1075 compliance review
